note: ADR 0789, 2026-11-23, done: the path is in the Studio's quit: a Studio that quits while the rcfd serve it has just started is not yet connected (spawned and not yet listening, or listening and not yet connected) left it running, detached; on Windows Playwright's close() then waits for ever on the pipes the service inherited, the test times out, the worker's teardown times out, and the forced end finds no parent to walk. Shown by records: 9 of 20 quits with the real engine left one, 6 of 6 with a stand-in engine, and one run printed the lead's two time-out lines and left one; project.spec.ts:245 takes this path but was not itself caught. Fix: nothing is spawned once the quit has begun, the child is known from the spawn on and ended by the quit, a child never connected to is ended; the tests' global teardown ends and prints what a run leaves. After it 0 of 26 quits left one, and 0 processes after each of 5 whole runs of npm test, 2 with a test made to time out; 6 mutations caught, one committed.

follow_ups.acceptance: Every limit not stated here is registered in the ADR before the run.
